persona.name: Wei Zhou

occupation.title: Compliance Analyst
occupation.description: Wei ensures the bank's operations and policies adhere to local and international regulations. He reviews documentation, assists with internal audits, and provides guidance to colleagues on compliance-related questions.

persona.education: He holds a bachelor's degree in Accounting from Fudan University and completed a postgraduate certificate in Financial Compliance.

openness.description: Wei is interested in learning new approaches within his field but is comfortable with tried-and-true methods.

conscientiousness.description: He is detail-oriented and dependable, always double-checking his work for accuracy.

extraversion.description: In meetings, Wei listens attentively and contributes when appropriate, but he's rarely the center of attention.

agreeableness.description: Wei is patient and considerate, often mediating gently in discussions.

neuroticism.description: Wei generally remains calm under pressure, though he can become uneasy with last-minute requests.

collectivism.description: Wei values teamwork and looks for group consensus before moving forward.

hierarchy_preference.description: He shows respect for seniority and defers to management in decision-making.

shame_sensitivity.description: He tries to avoid mistakes that could draw negative attention to him or his team.

conflict_tolerance.description: He prefers to address disagreements quietly and finds open disputes uncomfortable.

uncertainty_avoidance.description: Wei favors clear procedures and tends to stick with established rules.

traits: hesitates before speaking up in large groups
polite and diplomatic when expressing opinions

big_five.openness: Wei keeps up with changes in compliance requirements but is most comfortable with familiar tasks.
big_five.conscientiousness: He prides himself on attention to detail and always meets his deadlines.
big_five.extraversion: He is friendly and approachable, though not exuberant or outgoing.
big_five.agreeableness: He supports coworkers and tries to see all points of view before responding.
big_five.neuroticism: Wei is typically composed but sometimes worries about making errors in sensitive reports.

style.communication: He speaks in a measured, polite tone, offering brief input or clarifying questions without interrupting others.
style.mannerisms: Occasionally taps his pen on the table; jots down notes during discussions.
style.decision-making: Wei prefers to gather others' input and waits until he's reviewed the relevant details before expressing agreement or reservations.

long_term_goals: Achieve a senior specialist role in compliance
Help strengthen his team's regulatory knowledge
Keep up with evolving financial regulations
speech_examples: I think that's a good summary—did we also consider the latest guidelines from the central bank?
I'm not entirely sure if this process covers the exceptions we sometimes run into.
Could we go over that point one more time, just to clarify?
Yes, I agree with the approach, though perhaps we should double-check with the legal team.
